listed_sector_signals.signal: Cited reference to energy-management implementation in a wet cement production facility (continuous cement/clinker production), used only as prior-work context
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Castrillón et al. [19] reported
their results of the implementation of SGIE in a wet cement production facility, which showed an
increase in energy efﬁciency associated with a reduction in electricity consumption of 4.6%, achieved
without investment.

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50001 energy-management methodology and nZEB indicators to a university engineering-school (educational) building retrofitted from natural-gas heating to biomass-fueled district heating; continuous-industrial sectors appear only as cited references.
